modules.module_title: Assist in setting up different types of greenhouse

pcs.pc_description: assist in the selection of an appropriate type of greenhouse such as the lean-to, even or uneven span, ridge and furrow, saw tooth based on the relevant criteria such as the climate, topography, sunlight exposure, availability of quality water, market accessibility, etc.
assist the greenhouse installer in taking measurements and preparing a layout of the greenhouse
assist in organising the necessary materials such as wood, galvanized steel or iron, aluminium, glazing material, tools and equipment required for setting up the selected type of greenhouse
level the selected land as per the installer’s instructions before the installation of the greenhouse

assist in preparing the greenhouse structure and erecting it as per the prepared layout, ensuring good air-circulation, adequate sunlight exposure along with temperature and humidity control equipment

assist in installing the appropriate glazing material as per the plan such as Polycarbonate plastic, glass, Fibre-reinforced plastic (FRP), corrugated sheet, plastic film, Ultraviolet stabilised low-density polyethene, Silpaulin, etc.
Assist in Installation of wireless sensor networks or IOT based systems to regulate the greenhouse as per plan
assist in installing automated or non- automated irrigation or fertigation system as planned
arrange for safe drainage of excess water from the greenhouse and its protection from external threats such as stray animals, whiteflies, rodents, etc.
optimise the usage of water and other resources in various tasks and processes
plug water leakages to prevent its wastage

modules.module_title: Plant and maintain seeds, vegetables and plants

pcs.pc_description: ensure the availability of required planting material
prepare the raised, flat or sunken bed in the greenhouse as per the requirement
plant seeds, vegetables and different types of plants in the greenhouse
water the planted seeds, vegetables, flowers and plants with the recommended quantity
apply relevant fertilizers in the recommended quantity to promote the healthy growth of seedlings, vegetables and plants
check the seedlings, vegetables, flowers and plants to identify the signs of pests and disease
apply the recommended pesticides and insecticides to control pest and disease infestation
remove the dead and damaged seedlings, vegetables, flowers and plants
apply herbicides and weedicides and carry out manual weeding to prevent unwanted growth in the greenhouse
maintain the recommended temperature, humidity and sunlight exposure in the greenhouse
carry out regular repair and maintenance of the irrigation or fertigation system
maintain the manual and/ or electronic record of herbicides, weedicides fertilizers, pesticides and insecticides used in the greenhouse

modules.module_title: Harvest, acclimatise and transplant seedlings and plants

pcs.pc_description: check the readiness of the seedlings and plants for being transplanted
harvest the seedlings and plants ensuring no damage to them
acclimatise the seedlings and plants under the recommended temperature, protecting them from harsh conditions
transplant the acclimatised seedlings and plants in the garden
check the maturity of flowers and vegetables grown in the greenhouse
harvest the flowers and vegetables using the appropriate tools and collect them in appropriate baskets and/ or containers
store the harvested flowers and vegetables at the recommended temperature, humidity and hygienic conditions

modules.module_title: Carry out post-harvest processing and marketing of flowers and vegetables

pcs.pc_description: carry out sorting and grading of the flowers and vegetables
clean the vegetables using clean water and recommended cleaning agents
prepare the hydration solution and apply it to the flowers to maintain their freshness
market the flowers and vegetables to the customers visiting the greenhouse or to the regular market buyers
process the payments using the appropriate e-payment methods
maintain the record of sales and payments manually and/or electronically using the physical registers and/ or the relevant computer application
maintain cleanliness in the greenhouse through regular sweeping and removal of trash
check the greenhouse structure regularly to identify the repair and maintenance needs
carry out regular repair and maintenance of the greenhouse structure and co-ordinate with an expert for complex repairs
segregate waste into appropriate categories
dispose or recycle different types of wastes following the recommended practices
